issues.description: An org Admin (not just Owner) can DELETE the sole active Owner's entire membership row directly on kontrolia_auth.memberships via PostgREST/Supabase (governed by RLS policy "org admins remove memberships", a bare is_org_admin() check with no last-owner guard), which cascades (ON DELETE CASCADE) to membership_roles. The new migration-0025 trigger on membership_roles explicitly no-ops in this case (by design, to not break legitimate org-delete cascades: "if v_organization_id is null ... then return old" — the parent membership is already gone by the time the child trigger runs), so the cascade-deleted Owner role is never checked at all. This reproduces the exact last-owner-lockout outcome PQ-SEC-001/PQ-SEC-002/REQ-017's fixes were all meant to close, through a door none of them covered.

issues.description: The new resolveEmails() helper (added to fix PQ-PERF-002's N+1 problem) resolves emails by paging through GoTrue's listUsers() for the ENTIRE platform user base on every single request, rather than caching or scoping the scan to just the ids it needs — O(pages of all platform users) instead of O(members returned).
